findings.text: export.py imports the private helpers edit._base_token and segments._registered_physical_bases; it is the only production module in the package reaching into another module's underscore names, and segments exposes grammar_tokens_by_segment publicly, so the capability is reused but through a private surface.

The pass test asserts only result.passed and issues == [], never that halo_current is a 'process' token and not itself in quantity_tokens, so if the installed vocabulary stopped listing halo_current as a process token the test would pass vacuously with the exemption removed.
The landed test file has no trailing newline: ruff check reports W292 and `ruff format --check` would reformat it, so the committed file is not clean under the repository's own pre-stage ruff recipe.
